summary.text: Sly Karasinski is a Republican state representative from Cheshire 10 who has served in the House since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Karasinski has worked as a hospital security official.

paragraphs.text: Sly Karasinski's career experience includes working as a hospital security official, according to Ballotpedia.
He has been affiliated with the Marlow Fire and Ambulance.
